block_c_authority_graph.routing_note: Deliberately minimal. Only edges that are unambiguous from existing repository convention are declared. Declaring the full routing graph is the branch author's call -- see CONST_G3 -- and an assistant inventing it would be the same overreach this file forbids.
block_c_authority_graph.withhold_baseline_note: Removed. It was a ratchet on the number of unrouted files: the audit failed whenever that number grew. The canonical law is a classification default (unclassified fails closed to WITHHOLD), not a limit on how many files may exist, and the ratchet would have failed every run of Minerva's autonomous worker, which commits new result files. It was also stale on the commit that introduced it: the count was taken before the auditor and its test were staged, so CI saw 582 against a recorded 580. K2 now enforces that every declared routing edge resolves to a tracked path and names a declared class, and reports the unrouted count on every run.
